visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Zero Counts as a Power of Two
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 0 is not a power of two, but the program answers yes for it.

solution.explanation: For n = 0 the expression 0 & (0 - 1) is 0, so the bit trick alone reports true. Zero has no bit set at all, so it must be excluded with n > 0.
